examples.description: Fetch the register checks for a search result id, as a ChatGPT connector fetch

description: fetch = get company checks by id. The fetch tool that OpenAI's connector specification for ChatGPT names: pass the id of a search result (a 9-digit organisasjonsnummer) and get the company's register check bundle, one entry per check (registration status, bankruptcy and liquidation, VAT registration, roles, the coded signing rules, annual accounts and more), each with its own status: verified, missing, stale, unavailable, not_checked or review. There is no overall verdict. The result carries id, title, text (the bundle as JSON) and url (the register record), and keeps the Apier envelope (result, justification, metadata). Failure modes: VALIDATION_FAILED, NOT_FOUND, ENTITY_REMOVED, UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE; a credential without `read:brreg` cannot see the tool. Cost: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per call; Verify tier USD 0.01 from 2026-12-07 (get_pricing, /api/v1/pricing). Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp
description_nb: fetch betyr hent selskapets kontroller etter id. Verktøyet som spesifikasjonen fra OpenAI for ChatGPT-koblinger krever: gi id fra et søkeresultat (organisasjonsnummeret) og få kontrollene fra registrene, hver med egen status, uten en samlet konklusjon. Krever read:brreg. Kostnad: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per kall, forhåndsbetalt, Verify-nivået 0,10 kr fra 2026-12-07 (priser: verktøyet get_pricing eller GET /api/v1/pricing).
